title: Master and Disciple Again
summary: Yao Lao, awake after two years, learns that Xiao Yan has refined the Fallen Heart Flame, killed Han Feng and bound Medusa with a one-year deal. He warns that the Hall of Souls took Han Feng's soul and will hunt Xiao Yan, and Xiao Yan says they are tied to his father's disappearance. Han Feng's soul begs a Soul Envoy for mercy, says he knows the Hall's Dou Zun Old Mu Gu, and offers what Mu Gu wants. Yao Lao names three ingredients for a new body, the Bone Growing Blood Fusing Pill, the blood essence of a Rank Seven Magical Beast and a Dou Zong's skeleton, and agrees to study the Life Devouring Pill to save Xiao Li. Three months later, Xiao Yan returns to Feng City, sets the march on the Jia Ma Empire for two months away, and goes to the Inner Academy with Medusa. There Su Qian agrees to watch over the Xiao Gate, but warns that the academy can't openly help against the Misty Cloud Sect and Yun Shan, a Dou Zong.
